name: graphify-plugin
description: Let reverse-engineering (2.1) start from an external structural map instead of a cold scan, where that map is built by Graphify (https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify), which writes one under <repo>/graphify-out/. This plugin tells the Developer code scan to use it as an INDEX for deciding which files to open, tells the Architect synthesis to confirm every borrowed claim in the source file before it reaches a CodeKB artifact, and — because Graphify tags every edge EXTRACTED or INFERRED — lets that confirmation be spent where it is actually needed. Additive and overlay-only: no new stages, one contribution to reverse-engineering (Inception), plus the converter tool that turns a map into the workspace knowledge overlay and the query surface the stage can pull from. The map is evidence, never truth, and it never replaces reverse-engineering — that stage still owns the CodeKB store, whose freshness fingerprint only the tool can mint. Conditional throughout: with no map present nothing here asks for one and its absence is not a gap. This plugin and ua-plugin are alternatives, not layers — they wire the same seam for different tools, so compose exactly one of them into a tree.
